display.purpose: The delay-gate countdown only. The friction is the largest thing in the system.

headline.purpose: One per page: intercept and options h1.

label.purpose: 11px tracked uppercase; max two per surface.

data.purpose: Mono for URLs, counts, timestamps, kbd chips; tabular-nums.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrances (settle) and press feedback. Strong ease-out, no bounce.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: Intercept breathing dot; static at 0.7 opacity under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one clear action per screen; may embed a kbd hotkey chip.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #e2e0d9; background: #ffffff; color: #1a2029; font: 15px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s, filter 0.15s, transform 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary { background: #3563c4; border-color: #3563c4; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3563c4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-kbd { font: 11px/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 6px; min-width: 20px; text-align: center; } .ds-kbd-inverse { color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); background: transparent; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default button: card surface, line border, hover reveals Steady Blue.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #e2e0d9; background: #ffffff; color: #1a2029; font: 15px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, transform 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn2:hover { border-color: #3563c4; } .ds-btn2:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3563c4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: #5b6470; font: 15px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #1a2029; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3563c4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Card surface, line border; focus shifts border to Steady Blue, no glow.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="What are you actually looking for?">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e0d9; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; color: #1a2029; font: 15px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5b6470; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #3563c4; }

components.name: Queue Item
components.description: Flat list row: mono URL, mono timestamp, restore action.
components.css: .ds-qitem { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e0d9; border-radius: 6px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-qurl { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font: 12px/1.6 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; color: #1a2029; } .ds-qwhen { font: 11px/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; color: #5b6470; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-qbtn { padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e2e0d9; background: #ffffff; color: #1a2029; cursor: pointer; } .ds-qbtn:hover { border-color: #3563c4; }

components.name: Cap Gauge
components.description: One dot per tab: hollow = free, Steady Blue = occupied, Warn Red = over cap.
components.css: .ds-dots { display: flex; gap: 5px; } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid #e2e0d9; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-dot-on { background: #3563c4; border-color: #3563c4; } .ds-dot-over { background: #b3392b; border-color: #b3392b; }

components.name: Breathing Dot
components.description: The intercept's emotional anchor: a 4s respiratory pulse.
components.css: .ds-breath { display: block; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3563c4; opacity: 0.7; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-breath { animation: ds-breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.5; } 50% { transform: scale(1.6); opacity: 1; } } }

components.name: Reason Quote
components.description: The Your-Words treatment: the user's own typed reason, italic with a 2px Steady Blue rule.
components.html: I ship faster with seven tabs than seventy.
components.css: .ds-reason { font: italic 15px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #5b6470; border-left: 2px solid #3563c4; padding-left: 14px; text-align: left; max-width: 420px; }

narrative.overview: Named for the breathing dot at the top of the intercept screen: this system is a pause, not an alarm. It appears at the user's weakest moment — mid-impulse, about to open tab eight — and its entire job is to de-escalate. Warm paper surfaces, one steady blue voice, generous whitespace, and a slow four-second breathe animation set a tempo the user's pulse can borrow. Nothing flashes, counts down in red, or shames. The system is honest bookkeeping underneath the calm: tabular numerals, monospace URLs, visible kbd hotkey chips. It rejects SaaS dashboard chrome, tab-manager density, and guilt-trip theatrics.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, border-defined surfaces; zero box-shadows anywhere
Warm paper light theme, cool near-black dark theme, both first-class
One accent (Steady Blue) used sparingly; green and red reserved for outcomes, never decoration
System fonts only — the extension should feel like part of the browser
Motion is respiratory, not reactive: slow breathe, quick settle, strong ease-out

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Steady Blue is the only expressive color. If a screen needs a second accent, the screen is wrong, not the palette.

rules.name: The Earned Red Rule
rules.body: Warn Red appears only when the user is factually over cap or losing something real (a streak ≥2 days). It is information, never persuasion.

rules.name: The Your-Words Rule
rules.body: The user's typed reason is always italic, body-size, set off by a 2px Steady Blue rule — the most typographically distinct text on any screen it appears on. The app's own copy never gets this treatment.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs to feel raised, give it the Card background and a Line border. A box-shadow is a bug.

dos: Do keep every surface flat: Card + 1px Line border is the entire elevation vocabulary.
Do gate all animation behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference with a calm static default.
Do use the mono face for anything the user might audit: URLs, counts, timestamps, hotkeys.
Do give the user's own typed reason the Your-Words treatment (italic + 2px Steady Blue rule) wherever it appears.
Do use cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) for entrances and the press-scale for feedback; nothing bounces.
donts: Don't build "SaaS dashboard chrome" — no metric tiles, no gradients, no cards nested in cards.
Don't use guilt mechanics or urgency styling: no red countdowns, no streak-shaming, no pulsing warnings.
Don't add a second accent color, brand font, or logo flourish. One voice, system faces.
Don't densify toward tab-manager UI: no thumbnails, no folders, no multi-column lists.
Don't add box-shadows or a second backdrop blur beyond the gate scrim.
Don't uppercase-label every section; the 11px tracked label appears in at most two places per surface.
